# Stark Plumbing Solutions

> Stark Plumbing Solutions is a San Antonio, Texas plumbing contractor serving homes and businesses: emergency plumbing, drain cleaning, sewer line repair, leak detection, water heaters, repairs and installations. Customers get a written estimate and approve it before any work begins.

- Phone: (210) 898-9754
- Address: 1011 Ada St, San Antonio, TX 78223, USA
- Service area: San Antonio, TX and 60 neighborhoods
- Pricing: written estimate before work begins
